verdict.rationale: The skills write all of their outputs into a local `replica/` folder inside your own project, so artifacts stay on your disk rather than in a hosted service. At least one artifact is in an open format (`tokens.json`), and the bundled scripts are standard-library Python that never touch the network, so there is no evident lock-in. There is no documented export feature, though, and the formats of most other artifacts are unstated. Missing for 10: an explicit export/portability statement, documentation of the file formats for all generated artifacts (recon map, schema, test plans), and independent corroboration.
